Enum Class FaceppApiAddress

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Enum<FaceppApiAddress>
com.faceplusplus.spring.boot.FaceppApiAddress
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable, Comparable<FaceppApiAddress>, Constable
public enum FaceppApiAddress extends Enum<FaceppApiAddress>
Enumeration of all Face++ API endpoint addresses. Each constant holds a human-readable description, the HTTP method, and the URL template. URL templates may contain {0}, {1}, etc. placeholders that are resolved via getUrl(Object...).
Since:
3.0.0
Author:
[@Loong Wan](https://github.com/loong10k)
